description: Call a typed op of a cell-backed module in a collab.demo room (collab_state lists each module's `cell.ops` with their args). The relay checks your args against the module's contract, the module's own cell answers, and its change shows live in the room.

args.description: exactly the op's declared args (string, number or bool each)

link.description: the room link https://ce-net.com/collab/<code> (a host link carries ?host=<key>)

name.description: how you show up in the room, e.g. "Daniel's AI" (40 characters)

op.description: op name from the module's cell.ops

name: collab_op
